scope: Reverification of issue #67 T32 on the retained 10,895-Card fixture: read-only CLI/MCP commands against one isolated consistent copy; no apply, provider call or digest workflow ran.
sampling: One warm-up and three measured invocations per command, run sequentially on an otherwise idle host. Each invocation starts one zt mcp through the public test seam, which forwards every call to the real server and records tool, address count and process id.
